description:
Submit the user's answers to the questions from zebra_get_rc2_questions, all at once. This sends them to the
carrier, so confirm them with the user first.

On success, a licensed insurance agent at agency_phone finishes buying the policy with the user. Present
agency_call_message as written: it says whether the agency is open now or when it opens. Never tell the user to
call now when it says the agency is closed, and never promise a voicemail or a callback.
When continue_url is returned, also offer it: the user can finish online with a licensed insurance agent during
agency hours.
When price_status is in_progress, the carrier's final price is on its way: tell the user and follow
recommended_next.
If it fails with INVALID_ARGUMENTS, details names each answer that wasn't accepted: ask the user about just those,
then call again with every answer.
If it fails with an agency_phone, this quote can't be bought in chat right now. Call again if retryable is true.
Otherwise, or if it keeps failing, give the user agency_phone and the agency hours to finish with a licensed
insurance agent, or offer them another quote from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

If a VIN is rejected because it matches a different vehicle, ask the user whether the VIN or the vehicle is wrong.
For a wrong VIN, call again with the right one. For a wrong vehicle, call zebra_get_rc1_rates with the VIN's
vehicle only once the user agrees: the price changes, and they choose a quote again. Tell the user about each
vehicle_updates entry, and that the final price may differ from the earlier estimate. If you call
zebra_get_rc1_rates again, send the updated vehicle.

answers.description: Every answer, including the current_values the user kept, keyed by field_key (each part of a grouped question under its child_field_keys key). Answer a CHECKBOX question with a list of the chosen values, even when only one is chosen: ["Yes"], not "Yes".

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

name: zebra_submit_rc2_answers

agency_call_message.description: What to tell the user next: whether the agency is open now or when it opens, the phone number, and the agency hours. Present it as written.

agency_phone.description: The licensed agency the user calls to finish buying the policy.

continue_url.description: Where the user can finish online with a licensed insurance agent, by chat or over the phone, during agency hours.

price_status.description: in_progress: the carrier's final price is being fetched; follow recommended_next. unavailable: there won't be an automated final price; a licensed insurance agent gives it.

instruction.description: How and when to call it.

recommended_next.description: The tool to call next for the final price. Absent when price_status is unavailable.

vehicle_updates.description: Vehicles whose year or trim was changed to match the VIN the user gave. Tell the user. Absent when no vehicle changed.

field.description: The VIN answer that changed the vehicle.

message.description: What changed, to tell the user.
examples: We've updated your vehicle year to match your VIN for a 2020 Toyota Camry LE 4dr Sedan

title: Submit answers to the carrier
